incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A multi-storey building is partially collapsed, with rubble scattered on the ground. The scene shows significant structural damage with visible debris and intact upper floors.

observations.description: A building has collapsed, with visible destruction to the upper floors and a large pile of rubble at its base.
No visible water, but the ground is covered in debris and dust.
A tall pole stands near the rubble, and a large white sack is visible on the ground. Other buildings are visible in the background.
No visible people in the image.
Green trees are visible in the background, suggesting the area is not completely urban.

inconsistencies: The report mentions residents may still be inside, but no people are visible in the image.
not_determinable: Whether people are present inside the building
Whether dust covers the street (only debris is visible, not dust)
